1.title: Not just guilty or not - The jury's options in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial
1.summary: Jurors have five options before them as they decide the fate of the former nurse charged with murdering her three children.

2.title: Could Tupac verdict inspire new efforts to also find killer of his rap rival?
2.summary: The murder of Notorious B.I.G. was thought to be linked to the killing of his rival Tupac Shakur and it came up a lot in the trial.

3.title: Whistle-Blower Says Trump Officials Are Defying Court Orders on Voting by Mail
3.summary: A report detailed “grave concerns” that a new system being rushed into use by the U.S. Postal Service could imperil millions of mail ballots ahead of the midterm elections.

4.title: Can Ancient Ruins Be Protected From Wildfires? Greece Is Trying.
4.summary: As blazes surge across Europe, the country is making a trade-off to protect its heritage by fireproofing sites at the risk of spoiling the surrounding landscape.

5.title: Zambia's president sworn in for second term while opponent detained
5.summary: Hakainde Hichilema swept to victory, but his main rival is now in custody charged with treason.

6.title: Punishment and Silence: China Pulls Out the Disaster Playbook in Tibet
6.summary: While journalists can report freely on grief and anger in Nepal, China’s official media have presented a sanitized disaster aftermath in Tibet.
